title: Day One Pack
description: A simple datapack that gives you a starter kit when you begin your survival world. Perfect for players who want a smoother early game experience.
body:
**Day One Pack Datapack**

This datapack gives every new player a simple starter kit to help them survive the very beginning of the game without making it too easy. Perfect for players who want a smoother early game experience while still keeping the survival challenge.

When you join the world for the first time, you will automatically receive:

**1. Wooden Pickaxe**

**2. Stone Axe**

**3. 5 Bread**

**4. 4 Torches**

**5. Absorption I effect for 100 seconds (extra temporary hearts for protection)**

This ensures you have the basic tools, some food, light sources, and a short survival boost to safely start your journey. After the effect wears off, the game continues normally.

The kit is only given **once per player**, so it won’t repeat after death or rejoin.
